# Muhammad Wasif

> Full-Stack Software Engineer at PostEx (Lahore, Pakistan) specializing in fintech, payment systems, and event-driven microservices. Works with TypeScript, Java Spring Boot, Angular, and Node.js, and uses AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM code review) in his daily workflow. Awarded Emerging Star of the Year 2025 at PostEx Engineering.

## Highlights
- Core contributor to PostEx's Raast QR Payment on Delivery integration (State Bank of Pakistan instant payments), live in 6 cities
- Built a BNPL and Lending Management System serving 1,000+ merchants
- Implemented ELK-based distributed tracing across 6 microservices, cutting incident diagnosis time by ~50%
